tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gdams khrid don gyi mdo chings bzhugs so/ /gdams khrid don gyi mdo chings zhes bya ba/ dpal kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos grub char 'bebs dpal mgon bla ma dang*/ / mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho'i zhabs btud de/ /bla med rdo rje snying po'i theg pa 'dir/ /ji ltar 'jug tshul gnad kyi man ngag bri/ /dad pa rab dang ldan pa'i skal bzang gis/ /'khor ba'i gnas las brgal bar bya don du/ /dam pa'i bla ma rab tu mnyes byas te/ /sngon du gser la sogs pa'i maṇḍal phul/ /tshogs kyi 'khor los mchod nas gsol ba gdab/ /des kyang mtshan btags rjes su bzung byas la/ /lo zla'i sngon du bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang*/ /maṇḍal gsol 'debs lung 'bogs brtson par bya/ /dus la babs tshe dben pa'i gnas dag tu/ /sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen tshogs chas kun bsags la/ /thog mar spros bcas bum pa'i dbang bskur bya/ /de nas snod ldan rigs kyi bu rnams la/ /thun mong sngon 'gro lam khrid rdzogs par gdab/ /dmigs pa re la rab 'bring tha ma'i rim/ /zhag lnga gsum rer brtson pas nyams su blang*/ /de nas spros med gsang ba'i dbang bskur la/ /lam khrid chen mo shin tu 'byongs par gdab/ /dbang khrid gang byed sngon du maṇḍal dang*/ /brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dad gus tshad med bya/ khyad par khrid dmigs kun gyi sngon 'gro ru/ /maṇḍal gsol 'debs shin tu gces par bstan/ /'dis ni tshogs rdzogs sgṛb gnyis byang ba dang*/ /bla ma sgrub pa'i mchog gi snying por 'gyur/ /de yi byin rlabs rtogs pa shugs la 'char/ /ting 'dzin lhun grub gegs dang bar chad sel/ khrid dmigs re la rab 'bring sngar dang mtshungs/ khyad par sems kyi sngon 'gro'i dus dag tu/ /dri ba gzab la the tshom chod par bya/ /yun ring 'bad pas 'di yi rang gnad gzabs/ /gnas lugs rtogs pas shes rab rtsal la reg /de yi gnad du 'di las lhag pa med/

/zhag 'gas don gyi snying po dngos su mthong*/ /gdams pa'i khyad chos kun las 'phags pa yin/ /'og ma'i lam du lo mang bsgoms pa las/ /'di yi dmigs gnad zhag gcig don la nye/ /de bas mos gus brtson 'grus rab bskyed la/ /skad cig ma yengs bsam mno zhib mor gtang*/ /rtogs pa 'bul zhing the tshom chod par bya/ / don spyi'i sgom pas sems nyid rtogs dus med/ /rang gi ma mthong mun pa'i mda' 'phen 'dra/ /'dir ni rang gi dngos su mtshungs rtogs pas/ /rang rig chos sku 'od gsal nyi shar 'dra/ /yid dpyod blo bral mngon sum e ma ho/ /de nas dngos gzhi khregs chod ngo sprad la/ /gzhi grol zang ka rig pa'i thag chod grogs/ khyung chen la sogs mang nyung ci rigs bshad/ /zhag 'ga' de yi don la brtan chags bya/ /'di ni ka dag chos sku'i don chen te/ / lta ba'i rdzogs chen ngo mtshar rmad byung bas/ /thag chod dgongs pas gtan la phebs par bya/ /de nas thod rgal 'od gsal ngo sprod la/ /lhun grub rang gsal gzugs sku rang gnas don/ /rang byung nang gsal phyir snang yid ches bya/ /de yi gsal 'debs snang bzhi mtha' rten bstan/ /'bring dang tha ma'i gdams ngag rdzogs par bya/ khyad par du yang gnad kyi ngo sprod ni/ /gzhi lam 'bras gsum zhugs don gsum gnas dang*/ /ngo sprod rnam bzhi sgra 'od zer gsum dang*/ gsang lam thugs rje rgyun gyi ngo sprod rnams/ shin tu gzabs la gtan la phebs par bya/ /de nas dbang po'i tshad dang rab sbyor la/ khregs chod thod rgal rgyab chos ci 'os bshad/ /dad brtson che zhing sgrub nges gang zag la/ /nyams len lag khrid 'chugs med dngos su bstan/ khrid rgyab tshar nas tshogs kyi gtang rag bya/ /zla ba gsum gnyis gcig gis rim pa bzhin/ /rab 'bring tha ma'i dbang khrid gdams pa grub/ /de rjes brtson pas lo zlar nyams su blang*/ /'di dag thog ma'i gdams khrid man ngag go/ /de nas lo ni gcig la sogs pa na/

/skal bzang dad ldan brtson pa'i slob ma des/ /bla ma mchog la dbang rdzogs gsol ba gdab/ / des kyang ri rtse lung stong la sogs par/ /slob ma khrid la sngon 'gro spyod pa brtsam/ /sngon gyi lam 'khyer bogs 'byin rtsal sbyang bya/ /ru shan phyed nas shin tu spraus med dang*/ /rab tu spros med dbang rdzogs dus gcig bskur/ / dga' ston bya zhing dam bca' sgrub yon dbul/ /de nas gsang chen nges pa'i rgyud rnams dang*/ /lung dang man ngag gdams khrid rgya cher bstan/ /dad brtson sgrub la snying por byed rnams la/ /gsang ba'i gnad rnams ma lus tshang bar byin/ /bstan pa'i snying po 'dzin par nus rnams la/ /rgyud lung man ngag lung rnams tshang bar byin/ /brgyud pa'i byin rlabs chu bo 'bab pa la/ /gtad rgya bka' lung nges pa'i snying po byin/ /de las gzhan du bla ma mched mi gus/ /tshe 'di'i zhen pa can la gdam gzhug sba/ /ci phyir gdams kyang de la phan mi thogs/ /gsang ba'i gnad rnams 'chugs shing byin rlabs yal/ /bka' bsgo 'chol nas bka' chad 'byung ba'i phyir/ /snod dang mi ldan rnams la gsang zhing sba/ /snod ldan rnams la byinazhing bka' rgyas gdab/ /des ni bstan pa'i snying po yun ring gnas/ /spyir na gsang sngags dbang khrid man ngag la/ khrigs chags dang ni dum bu'i lugs gnyis te/ / skal ldan yang rab rnon po'i rigs rnams la/ /dbang bzhi dus gcig gdams khrid khrigs chags gsungs/ /'on kyang brtag dka' mngon shes mi ldan phyir/ /phyag bzhes nyid la dum bu'i lugs 'di mdzad/ /de bas 'di nyid shin tu legs par mngon/ /skal ldan yin na bsgug longs yod pa dang*/ /don gnyer che bas cis kyang rdzogs par thob/ /skal ba yod med rang bzhin mi shes par/ /zab mo'i dbang khrid dus gcig rdzogs par gdab/ /gsang sgo 'chol na dpon slob gnyis ka la/ /mkha' 'gro grub pa can gyi bka' chad 'byung*/ /de bas dum skyong 'khrid pa'i thabs zab 'di/

/ sngon byung bla mas snyan brgyud rin chen rnams/ /rim gyis 'khrid pa'i lo rgyus yid ches mthong*/ kho bos kyang ni rig 'dzin bla ma la/ /rab 'bring tha ma'i zhabs tog sri zhu byas/ /mnyes bzhin pa yis thugs rjes bzung ba las/ / dum bu'i lugs su bar bar gnad rnams thos/ /lo drug song rjes dbang bzhi rdzogs pa dang*/ /phra mo'i gdams khrid ngo sprod gtad rgya thob/ /de bas gsang chen don gyi theg pa 'di/ /shin tu zab drags gnyan la babs che bas/ /lo re zla res zhus dag ga la chod/ /yun du sgrub cing yun du ja ma brten/ /yun du bsrings pa don chen yun gyis 'grub/ /ngang thung res 'jog yon tan thob dus med/ /zab cing rgya che bstan pa'i snying po 'di/ /mkha' ltar rgya che zab cing rtogs dka' bas/ /bla ma brten zhing sgrub pa yun bsrings pas/ /chos rnams rdzogs shing mthar thug nges pa rnyed/ /de phyir rim gyis dum skyong gnad du che/ /phyin chad rjes su 'jug pa'i bu rnams kyis/ /dbang khrid gdams pa de ltar brten par bya/ /bla ma'i bka' rgya yin no snying la phur/ /rjes 'jug gtad rgya yin no dam du zung*/ /nges pa'i snying gtam yin no brtson pas sgrubs/ /snying po'i gdams pa yin no zad sar skyol/ /gtso bo dam tshig yin no rnam dag srungs/ /byin rlabs rtsa ba yin no mos gus skyed/ /dngos grub rtsa ba yin no sgrub la rems/ /bla mas byin gyis brlab kyis gsol ba thob/ /yi dam dngos grub ster gyis bskyed rdzogs sgoms/ /mkha' 'gros stong grogs byed kyis tshogs gtor shoms/ /bka' srung bar chad sel gyis mchod la brtson/ /tshe 'di 'khrul pa yin gyis zhen pa chod/ /cis kyang dgos med yin gyis dngos 'dzin thong*/ /gdams pa'i mthar thug yin gyis sems nyid ltos/ /'dir bde phyi mar skyid kyis chos rang mdzod/ /'jig rten bya ba btang na ngang gis bde/

/snang ba chos la bsgyur na des kyang bde/ /zab don snying po bsgrubs na shin tu bde/ /gnas lugs zad sar skyol na los kyang bde/ /de bas skal ldan mos gus yod pa rnams/ /gdams pa'i mchog 'di nan tan snying por mdzod/ /tshe 'dir 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho rab brgal nas/ /zhi ba byang chub mya ngan 'das thob 'gyur/ /tshul 'di gdams khrid don gyi snying po'i chings/ /ma 'ongs skal ldan rnams la gdams pa ste/ /rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub par byed don du/ /ma nor ma 'khrul go rim lag khrid bsdebs/ /dge ba 'di yis ma lus 'gro ba kun/ /mngon par byang chub mdzad pa mtha' yas shog /gdams khrid don gyi mdo chings zhes bya ba/ theg pa rgyal po'i rnal 'byor pa klong chen rab 'byams kyis/ gangs ri thod dkar gyi mgul/ kun tu bzang po'i nags nang*/ zla ba chu shel gyi khang bzangs su legs par sbyar ba rdzogs so// // dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o// //
